candidates.description: This vector activates for Hindi temporal and conditional adverbs related to time and circumstance.
This feature vector activates strongly for characters, suffixes, and morphemes specific to the Hindi language script and Devanagari transliteration.
This feature vector represents common Hindi syllables, characters, and fragmentary word pieces encoding textual data.
This vector activates for specific Devanagari script characters and phonetic sub-syllable tokens.
This vector is related to Hindi words and characters featuring the vowel sign matra 'aa' (ा).
This vector represents common Hindi or Sanskrit characters, vowel signs, and conjunct consonants used in Indic script typography and encoding.
This feature vector activates on subword tokens and fragments common across multiple languages.
This feature vector represents common subword tokens and characters in the Devanagari script used for languages like Hindi and Sanskrit.
This vector represents common Hindi vowel matras (dependent vowel signs) and punctuation marks often found in Devanagari text processing.
This feature vector represents common subword tokens and morphological roots in Hindi text.
